responsibility: Render awakening delivery settings for notification, location and health permissions plus geofence, emotion and anniversary controls without duplicating Core awakening rules

inputs.authorization: Live notification, location and health authorization/availability values
inputs.settings: Live geofence, emotion and anniversary enablement values
inputs.runtimeStatus: Loading, error and unavailable states from the UI adapter

outputs.visibleContent: Apple-native grouped permission and awakening-setting controls with shared status/action hierarchy
outputs.interactionTargets: Toggle controls, notification request, system settings link and geofence detail presentation
outputs.accessibilityTree: Form reading order with stable labels, values, hints and permission status

fallbackConditions: Masonry is always forbidden for this Task surface
Unavailable system capabilities render an explanatory status instead of a disabled visual-only control
description: Awakening delivery settings — notification, location, health permissions and geofence/emotion/anniversary toggles
